document.abstract: A 35mm reflex camera system has been developed, incorporating closed-circuit television for electronic viewfinding, remote monitoring and video taping for instant playback. The development problems and their solutions are discussed with a description of the system in its final form. The uses and advantages of the system in motion-picture production are also discussed.
